What happens after you order

You only pay at the end, once Premium is live on your account. Expect about ten minutes of your time in total.

  1. 1

    You pick a plan and give the email address of your LinkedIn account.

    It's a short form, with no password and no card.

  2. 2

    WhatsApp opens with your order already written.

    Someone from the team confirms it and sends you a secure link.

  3. 3

    You send your login details through that link.

    The link is personal and expires. Your password is encrypted, then deleted once activation is done. You can change it right after.

  4. 4

    Premium is switched on for your account.

    Allow 5 to 30 minutes after we receive your login details, during our opening hours. Every update email includes a tracking link.

  5. 5

    You pay on WhatsApp.

    Once you can see Premium on your account, we tell you the amount and how to pay. If activation doesn't work out, you pay nothing.

Common questions

Can't find your answer? Message us on WhatsApp, it's the fastest way.

Is billing annual?

Yes. You pay once for 12 months. If you'd rather pay monthly, ask on WhatsApp before you order.

When and how do I pay?

After activation. Once Premium shows on your account, someone from the team tells you the amount and the payment method on WhatsApp. The site never asks for a card.

Do I have to share my LinkedIn password?

Yes, once, through a personal link that expires. The password is encrypted during activation, then deleted. You can change it as soon as Premium is active.

What if activation fails?

You pay nothing. Payment only happens once Premium is live on your account.

Who can get the student price?

Students and recent graduates. Career drops from €80 to €60 and Business from €120 to €80. We may ask for proof, such as a student card or a graduation certificate. Sales Navigator and Recruiter Lite have a single price.

Can I earn money by recommending Kareer?

Yes, in two ways. Customers: your referral code arrives when your order is activated; whoever orders with it pays €10 less and you earn €10 as soon as they have paid (referral page). Anyone, customer or not (students, content creators, employees): become an ambassador with your own code, once the team accepts you (ambassador programme). Either way, your balance is transferred to you or pays for your own subscription.

Where do the LinkedIn prices come from?

They are LinkedIn Premium's public prices in France on annual billing: Career €29.99 a month, Business €55 a month, Sales Navigator Core €89.99 a month and Recruiter Lite €123.96 a month.

Is Kareer part of LinkedIn?

No. Kareer is an independent service with no connection to LinkedIn Corporation.

Talk to someone on the team

On WhatsApp we reply Monday to Friday from 9am to 8pm and on Saturday from 10am to 6pm. By email, allow one working day.
